title: Al Jazeera journalist opens beach cafe in the Gaza she loves
english: Hind Khoudary, a journalist for Al Jazeera, has launched a new beach cafe in Gaza as a way to reclaim a sense of normalcy amidst the ongoing conflict. She created this space to provide a safe environment where local residents can connect and find a moment of peace during difficult times. Through this initiative, she aims to preserve a cherished aspect of Gazan life despite the surrounding devastation.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ ሂንድ ኩዳሪ በጋዛ ውስጥ አዲስ የባህር ዳርቻ ካፌ ከፍታለች። ይህም በጦርነት ለተጎዳው አካባቢ ነዋሪዎች አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩም መገናኛ እና መረጋጋት የሚፈጥርበት ቦታ እንዲሆን ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው። ጋዜጠኛዋ በዚህ ተግባሯ በጋዛ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ባህል ለማስቀጠል እና ለህዝቡ ትንሽም ብትሆን ሰላማዊ ጊዜ ለመፍጠር ትጥራለች።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun Al Jazeera Hind Khoudary, magaalaa Gaazaatti kafee bakka bashannana qarqara galaanaa tokko banatteetti. Kafeen kun, yeroo waraanaafi rakkoo cimaa keessa jiran kanatti, ummanni wal arguufi xiqqoo ta'us tasgabbii argachuuf bakka itti fayyadaman ta'a jedhamee yaadameera. Tarkaanfiin kun, akkaataa jireenyaa durii Gaazaatti beekamu sana rakkoo waraanaafi diiggaa jiru cinaatti akkasumas lubbuun jiraachisuuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Houthis launch sixth ballistic missile at Marib city
english: Houthi forces recently conducted their sixth ballistic missile strike on the Yemeni city of Marib, resulting in significant property damage. These repeated attacks have severely endangered civilians, including those living in refugee camps and residential areas. Previous strikes in the region have already caused multiple injuries and destroyed homes, vehicles, and local businesses.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ማሪብ ከተማ ላይ ስድስተኛውን የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ተደጋጋሚ እየሆነ የመጣው ይህ ጥቃት በከተማዋ ለሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች እና ለተፈናቃዮች ካምፖች ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። ከዚህ ቀደም በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን የቤት ንብረቶችና ተሽከርካሪዎችም ወድመዋል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin magaalaa Ma'arib kan Yamanitti xiyyaara kombattuu (ballistic missile) ja'affaa harcaasee jira. Haleellaan deddeebi'ee gaggeeffamaa jiru kun jireenya namoota nagaa fi qubata godaantotaa balaa hamaa irra buusee jira. Haleellaa darban kanaan namootni hedduun miidhamaa fi qabeenyi namoota nagaa kanneen akka manaa fi konkolaataa barbadaa'anii jiru.

title: Explosions heard in Lebanon's Nabatieh as Israel continues strikes
english: Israel conducted new airstrikes in Lebanon's Nabatieh district, causing several explosions near the town of Kfar Reman. These raids occurred shortly after a separate series of attacks killed 11 people, marking the highest casualty count since the recent ceasefire. Tensions in the region remain significantly elevated following these latest military operations.
amharic: እስራኤል በሊባኖስ ናባቲህ ግዛት አዲስ የአየር ጥቃት የፈጸመች ሲሆን በከፋር ሬማን ከተማ አካባቢ በርካታ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት 11 ሰዎችን የገደለው ቀደም ሲል ከተካሄደው የአየር ጥቃት በኋላ ነው። ይህ ሁኔታ በቅርቡ ከተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት የቀጠፈ ክስተት ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል።
oromo: Isiraa'el naannoo Naabaatiyeh kan Libaanoos keessatti haleellaa qilleensa irraa haaraa gaggeessiteen, magaalaa Kfar Reman biratti dhoohiinsi cimaan dhaga'ameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame namoota 11 ajjeese erga haleellaa duraa raawwatamee booda. Kunis walii galtee waraana dhaabuu dhiheenya kana irra ga'amee booda balaa cimaa tasa uumame dha.

title: Opinion: How a pragmatic axis could reshape the Middle East
english: The Middle East is moving beyond its traditional power struggle between Iran's proxy network and the US-backed Israeli security framework. A new influential bloc, referred to as a Sunni axis, is beginning to take shape with leadership from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan. This shift suggests that the region's long-standing political dynamics are being fundamentally reorganized into a more complex three-part structure.
amharic: የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ከአሁን በፊት በነበረው የኢራን ተፅዕኖ እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል የደህንነት ማዕቀፍ መካከል የነበረውን ፍጥጫ እያለፈ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን የሚመሩት አዲስ የሱኒ ሀገራት ቡድን ብቅ እያለ ነው። ይህ ለውጥ የቀጠናው የረጅም ጊዜ የፖለቲካ አሰላለፍ ወደ ውስብስብ የሶስትዮሽ ቅርፅ እየተቀየረ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hala siyaasaa Baha Giddu galeessaa durii kan ture walitti bu'iinsa Iran fi tumsa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el darbee, ammaan tana gara caalaatti jijjiiramaa jira. Gareen biyyoota Sunniin durfamu kan akka Sa'udii Arabiyaa, Turkaayii fi Paakistaan walitti dhufeenyaan hundaa'aa jira. Jijjiiramni kun caasaa siyaasaa naannichaa kan durii sun gara caasaa sadetti kan qoodamee fi caalaatti walxaxaa ta'eetti jijjiiramaa jiraachuu agarsiisa.

title: Prosecutors Charge Seven Alleging Amhara Bank’s Credit Controls Bend for One Borrower
english: Federal prosecutors have filed corruption and abuse of power charges against seven individuals and a private company. The accused include several former high-ranking executives from Amhara Bank and the leadership of Zemera Investment Group. These charges stem from allegations that they illegally bypassed credit regulations in foreign trade deals, resulting in a loss of over 137 million Birr for the bank.
amharic: የፌደራል አቃቤ ህግ በአማራ ባንክ ላይ ከ137 ሚሊዮን ብር በላይ የገንዘብ ብክነት አድርሰዋል በሚል ሰባት ግለሰቦችና አንድ የግል ድርጅት ላይ ክስ መስርቷል። በተከሳሽነት የቀረቡት የባንኩ የቀድሞ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የባንኩ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች እና የዜሜራ ኢንቨስትመንት ግሩፕ ኃላፊዎች ናቸው። ተከሳሾቹ በውጭ ንግድ ስምምነቶች ወቅት የብድር መመሪያዎችን በመጣስ ለሙስና እና ለስልጣን ያለአግባብ መጠቀም ተግባር ተጠያቂ መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa federaalaa namoota torbaafi dhaabbata dhuunfaa tokko irratti himata malaammaltummaafi aangoo gandaa fayyadamuu dhiyeesseera. Himatamtoota keessatti hooggantoonni olaanoo Baankii Amharaa duraanii fi hooggantoonni dhaabbata 'Zemera Investment Group' kan argaman yoo ta'u, isaanis waliigaltee daldala alaa keessatti seera baankii cabsuun qarshii miliyoona 137 ol baankicharraa akka bade shakkamu.

title: Addis Abeba Builds Over Its Waterways. Now the Floods Find a Way Back
english: Addis Ababa is facing severe flooding issues caused by urban development that has encroached upon natural waterways. The tragedy of an 11-year-old boy who went missing after falling into a hidden, uncovered drain highlights the dangerous consequences of poor city planning. Experts argue that the city's recurrent flooding is not a natural disaster but a direct result of design failures in its infrastructure.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር በተፈጥሯዊ የውሃ መተላለፊያ መንገዶች ላይ ግንባታዎችን ማከናወኑ ለከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ እየዳረገው ይገኛል። በጀሞ አካባቢ የ11 ዓመት ልጅ በጎርፍ ተሸፍኖ በነበረ ክፍት የውሃ ማፍሰሻ ውስጥ ወድቆ መጥፋቱ የከተማዋን ደካማ የመሠረተ ልማት ዝግጅት አጋልጧል። የከተማዋ ጎርፍ በተፈጥሮ የሚከሰት ሳይሆን የተሳሳተ የከተማ ፕላን ውጤት መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Magalaan Finfinnee bakka bishaan gadi ba'uuf uumamanii turan irratti ijaarsa gaggeessuun ishee lolaa hamaaf akka saaxilamtu ishee godheera. Mucaan waggaa 11 tokko iddoo lolaan haguugee ture keessatti bishaan duubatti awwaalame keessatti kufuu isaa fi baduun isaa, rakkoo karoora magaalichaa kan agarsiisuudha. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, lolaan magaalattii keessatti deddeebi'ee mudatu kun balaa uumamaa osoo hin taane, dogoggora ijaarsa magaalichaa irraa kan madde dha.

title: Ethio-post Turns Branches into Banks as Banks Close Theirs
english: Ethio-post is transforming its 3,000 nationwide branches into financial service hubs that allow customers to manage bank accounts, pay bills, and handle cash transactions. Working alongside the ET-switch payment network, the state postal service has already launched a pilot program in 700 locations. This initiative aims to modernize the historic institution by integrating it into the country's formal banking infrastructure within the next month.
amharic: ኢትዮ-ፖስት በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ያሉትን 3,000 ቅርንጫፎቹን የባንክ አገልግሎት መስጫ ማዕከላት ለመቀየር እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ደንበኞች በቅርንጫፎቹ አማካኝነት ገንዘብ ማውጣትና ማስገባት፣ የፍጆታ ክፍያዎችን መፈጸም እንዲሁም የባንክ ሂሳቦቻቸውን ማስተዳደር ይችላሉ። የኢቲ-ስዊች ክፍያ መረብን በመጠቀም በ700 ቅርንጫፎች የሙከራ ስራ የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ሙሉ በሙሉ ስራውን በአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ለማስጀመር ታቅዷል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa Poostaan dameewwan isaa 3,000 gara bakka tajaajila baankii kennuutti jijjiiruuf qophaa’aa jira. Tajaajilli kun maamiltoonni maallaqa akka baasan, galchan, kaffaltii tajaajilaa akka raawwatanii fi herreega baankii isaanii akka hogganan kan dandeessisuudha. Walitti hidhamiinsa marsaa kaffaltii 'ET-switch' fayyadamuun dameewwan 700 irratti hojiin qorannoo eegaleera; guyyoota soddoman dhufan keessattis tajaajilli kun guutuu biyyattii keessatti kan eegalu ta'a.

title: Minister Threatens to Blacklist Traders Who Break Export Deals
english: The Ethiopian Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration is implementing strict penalties to address a record number of broken export contracts. Foreign buyers who repeatedly default will be banned from trading with the country for one year, while local exporters face temporary suspension of their permits. Repeat offenders among local businesses will have their trading licenses permanently revoked.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ንግድና ቀጠናዊ ትስስር ሚኒስቴር የወጡ የውጭ ንግድ ውሎችን ባለማክበር የሚፈጸሙ ጥሰቶችን ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰደ ነው። እንደ አዲሱ አሰራር፣ በተደጋጋሚ ውል የሚያፈርሱ የውጭ ገዢዎች ለአንድ ዓመት ከኢትዮጵያ ጋር እንዳይገበያዩ ይከለከላሉ። በአገር ውስጥ ያሉ ላኪዎችም የንግድ ፈቃዳቸው ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ታግዶ፣ ተደጋጋሚ ጥሰት በሚፈጽሙት ላይ ግን የንግድ ፈቃዳቸውን ሙሉ በሙሉ የመሰረዝ እርምጃ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Ministeerri Daldalaa fi Walitti Hidhamiinsa Naannawaa Itoophiyaa waliigaltee ergaa alaa cabsuu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'eera. Gurgurtoota biyya alaa waliigaltee irra deddeebi'anii cabsan irratti waggaa tokkoof daldala irratti hirmaachuu irraa dhorkaan kan jiraatu yoo ta'u, ergaa alaa ergitoota biyya keessaa irrattis hayyamni daldalaa isaanii yeroof ni uggurama. Daldaltoonni biyya keessaa irra deddeebi'anii waliigaltee cabsan hayyama daldalaa isaanii guutummaatti ni dhabu.

title: Supreme Court Widens Shield for Lawyers Fighting the VAT
english: The Federal Supreme Court has extended legal protection to lawyers across several regional states who are challenging a government directive to register for VAT. The court's appellate bench has issued a temporary injunction that prevents the Ministry of Finance from enforcing the tax registration requirement on these attorneys. This stay will remain in place until a final ruling determines whether the government's tax mandate is lawful.
amharic: የፌደራል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ለተጨማሪ የክልል ጠበቆች የተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ ምዝገባን ከመፈጸም ነጻ የሚያደርግ ጊዜያዊ እገዳ ሰጥቷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር የወጣውን መመሪያ በመቃወም ላይ ለሚገኙ ጠበቆች የሰጠውን ከለላ ወደ አማራ፣ ሲዳማ፣ ደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ እና ቤኒሻንጉል ጉሙዝ ክልሎች አስፍቷል። ይህ ትእዛዝ መመሪያው ህጋዊነት እስኪረጋገጥ ድረስ ተግባራዊ የሚሆን ይሆናል።
oromo: Mana murtii waliigalaa federaalaa abukaattoota naannolee garaagaraa keessa jiran kanneen dirqama galmee gibira dabalataa (VAT) mormaa jiranaf ittisa seeraa bal'iseera. Mana murtichaa ajaja yeroon abukaattoonni kunneen hanga murtii dhumaa argatutti gibira kaffaluu irraa bilisa akka ta'an murteesseera. Murtiin kun hanga seera qabeessummaan qajeelfama ministeera maallaqaa mirkanaa'utti kan itti fufu ta'a.

title: As petrol prices soar, electric bikes gain ground in Nigeria
english: In Nigeria, the significant rise in petrol prices following the removal of fuel subsidies has led many people to switch to electric motorcycles. While these bikes have a high upfront cost, riders find them much more affordable to operate and maintain than traditional gas-powered vehicles. This transition is also helping to reduce air pollution in urban areas by eliminating harmful exhaust emissions.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ የነዳጅ ድጎማ መነሳቱን ተከትሎ የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ ኤሌክትሪክ ሞተር ሳይክሎች እንዲሸጋገሩ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን የኤሌክትሪክ ሞተር ሳይክሎች የመግዣ ዋጋቸው ከፍተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ተጠቃሚዎች ከነዳጅ እና ከጥገና ወጪ አንጻር ከፍተኛ ቁጠባ እያገኙ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ለውጥ በአካባቢ ብክለት ላይ የሚኖረውን አሉታዊ ተፅዕኖ በመቀነስ ረገድም ፋይዳ አለው።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaa keessatti mootummaan gargaarsa gatii boba’aa waan dhiiseef, gatiin boba’aa ol ka’uun isaa namoonni hedduun gara mootar-sayikilii elektirikiitti akka jijjiiraman taasiseera. Mootar-sayikiliin kun gatii bituu irratti qaalii ta’us, namoonni fayyadaman gatii boba’aa fi suphaa irratti qusannoo guddaa gochuun isaanii ni dubbatu. Jijjiirraan kun faalama qilleensaa hir’isuun naannoo keenya eeguufis gahee guddaa qaba.

title: Army drops roses on Syrian crowds in a far cry from war
english: Syrian military helicopters recently showered flower petals over people attending a festival at the Damascus Citadel. This symbolic gesture marks an effort by the government to restore public cultural activities and promote a sense of normalcy following the conclusion of the civil war. The event highlights a notable shift in atmosphere as the country looks to move past its recent history of intense conflict.
amharic: የሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ሄሊኮፕተሮች በደማስቆ ሲታዴል በተካሄደ የፌስቲቫል ስነስርዓት ላይ ለተገኙ ህዝቦች ጽጌረዳዎችን በትነዋል። ይህ ምልክታዊ ድርጊት መንግስት ከረጅም አመታት የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት በኋላ ባህላዊ ዝግጅቶችን ለማደስ እና ሰላማዊ ሁኔታን ለመፍጠር እያደረገ ያለውን ጥረት ያሳያል። ክስተቱ ሀገሪቱ ካለፈችበት አስከፊ ጦርነት ወጥታ ወደ መደበኛ ህይወት ለመመለስ እያደረገች ያለውን ለውጥ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Heelikopteroonni waraana Siiriyaa magaalaa Damaasqoo keessatti ayyaana tokko irratti namoota walgahaniif roozii biifaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan waraana waggoota hedduu booda aadaa fi jireenya hawaasummaa deebisanii ijaaruuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha. Gochi kun biyyattiin miidhaa waraana darbee booda gara tasgabbii fi jireenya idileetti deebi'uuf hawwii qabaachuu ishee ibsa.

title: Hamas leader heads to Cairo for Gaza talks ahead of Kushner visit
english: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya is traveling to Cairo to hold discussions with Egyptian intelligence officials regarding the ongoing Gaza conflict. This visit comes ahead of a planned Middle East trip by Jared Kushner, who aims to address a peace plan recently rejected by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Hamas continues to urge mediators to pressure Israel into accepting a ceasefire roadmap while military hostilities in Gaza persist.
amharic: የሃማስ ከፍተኛ መሪ ካሊል አል-ሃያ ስለ ጋዛ ቀውስ ለመወያየት ወደ ካይሮ ጉዞ አድርገዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የዩናይትድ ስቴትሱ ተወካይ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በክልሉ ከማድረጋቸው በፊት የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ ዓላማውም በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ውድቅ የተደረገውን የሰላም ዕቅድ ለማነጋገር ነው። ሃማስ አሜሪካ እና ሌሎች አሸማጋዮች እስራኤል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን እንድትቀበል ጫና እንዲያደርጉ አሁንም እየጠየቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Hamas, Khaliil al-Hayyaan, dhimma waraana Gaazaarratti mari'achuuf gara Kaayiroo imalaa jiru. Imalli kun kan ta'e, ergamaan Amerikaa Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa isaan duraan Pirezidaantii Israa'el Binyamiin Neetanyaahuun morman irratti mari'achuuf gara Baha Giddu-galeessaa dhufuuf qophaa'aa jiranitti. Hamas gama isaatiin, waraanni Gaazaa keessatti itti fufuun isaa kan isaan yaaddessu ta'uu ibsuun, gama kanaan araara buusuuf dhiibbaan akka godhamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Talks on Hormuz Strait continue; Israel kills 11 in Lebanon
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated as Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon resulted in at least 11 deaths, marking the most significant violence since the June ceasefire. Meanwhile, Iranian officials are negotiating with Oman regarding security in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran stated that the full reopening of this vital shipping lane remains contingent on the United States honoring their previous agreement.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎች መገደላቸው በሰኔ ወር ከተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ከፍተኛው ጥቃት ሆኗል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር የመርከብ እንቅስቃሴ ዙሪያ ከኦማን ጋር ውይይት እያደረገች ነው። ኢራን እንዳስታወቀችው ከሆነ፣ ይህንን የባህር መንገድ ሙሉ በሙሉ መክፈት የሚቻለው አሜሪካ ቀደም ሲል የተፈራረሙትን ስምምነት ስታከብር ብቻ ነው።
oromo: Isiraa'el kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa qilleensaan raawwatte kanaan namoonni 11 ol du'anii jiru; kunis waraana ji'a Waxabajjii dura dhaabbatee ture booda haleellaa hammaataa ta'e dha. Gama biraatiin, Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz irratti nageenya eeguuf biyya Oomaan waliin mari'achaa jirti. Iraan akka ibsiteratti, daandii galaana kana bakka duraatti deebisuun kan danda'amu yoo Ameerikaan walii galtee kanaan dura mallatteessite kabajje qofa dha.

title: Yemen’s government says Houthi strikes hit residential areas in Marib
english: The Yemeni government has condemned the Houthi group for launching a series of ballistic missiles and drone attacks against residential neighborhoods and displaced persons camps in Marib. These strikes have caused multiple injuries and significant property damage, further endangering the millions of people who have sought refuge in the city. This violence is part of a broader recent escalation in hostilities across the country that has resulted in numerous casualties on both sides.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት ሁቲዎች በመሪብ ከተማ በሚገኙ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እና ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ ካምፖች ላይ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል እና ድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አውግዟል። ይህ ጥቃት በከተማዋ ተጠልለው ለሚገኙ በሚሊዮን ለሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ሕይወት ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ በሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ ንብረት እንዲወድም አድርጓል። ድርጊቱ በየመን እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት አካል ሲሆን በሁለቱም ወገኖች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen gareen Houtii magaalaa Maariib keessatti iddoowwan jireenyaa fi bakka buqqaattonni itti qubatan irratti weerara misaa'elaa fi dooniiwwan (drones) gaggeessuu isaa balaaleffateera. Weerarri kun namoota miliyoonaan lakkaawaman magaalaa sana keessa jiran irratti miidhaa guddaa kan qaqqabsiise yoo ta'u, qabeenyaa fi lubbuu irrattis miidhaan ga'eera. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa Yemen keessatti hammaachaa jiru keessaa isa tokko yoo ta'u, gartuuwwan lamaan irrattis lubbuun namoota hedduu darba jira.

title: At least five reported dead amid flooding in US state of Indiana
english: Severe storms and heavy rainfall over the past week have caused historic flooding in Indiana, resulting in at least five deaths. Rescue teams are actively working to save stranded residents as the state faces its worst flooding in over three decades. Governor Mike Braun has secured a commitment for federal emergency aid from the U.S. government to support ongoing recovery efforts.
amharic: ባለፈው ሳምንት በኢንዲያና ግዛት የጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ እና የተከሰተው ጎርፍ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። ግዛቱ ከሰላሳ ዓመታት በላይ ባልታየ ደረጃ በከባድ ጎርፍ በመመታቱ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ተጎጂዎችን ለማውጣት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። የኢንዲያና ገዢ ማይክ ብራውን ከፌዴራል መንግስት ድንገተኛ የገንዘብ እና የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Torban darbe keessa naannoo Indiyaanaa keessatti rooba cimaa roobeen uumamee fi balaan lolaa lubbuu namoota shan galaafateera. Balaan lolaa kun waggoota soddoma darban keessatti kan hin mudanne waan ta'eef, hojjettoonni gargaarsaa namoota bishaan keessatti hafan oolchuuf tattaaffii bal'aa gochaa jiru. Gamtichi, mootummaan federaalaaa gargaarsa ariifachiisaa akka godhuuf waadaa akka galeef gitaa biyyattii Maayik Biraawuniin beeksisaniiru.

title: Colombia asks Trump to suspend tariffs as country reels from earthquake
english: Following a devastating 7.4-magnitude earthquake that killed nearly 300 people and caused massive destruction, Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has requested that Donald Trump temporarily pause new U.S. tariffs. The country faces an estimated $6.4 billion reconstruction bill, and the leader hopes this trade relief will help local businesses recover. Despite a friendly relationship between the two presidents, the U.S. had previously imposed these tariffs on many trading partners due to concerns over labor policies.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በደረሰው የ7.4 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ወደ 300 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ህይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ፣ የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ ከአሜሪካው አቻቸው ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ውይይት አድርገዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ አገሪቱ ከምትገኝበት አስከፊ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስ ለማገገም እና መልሶ ግንባታ ለማካሄድ 6.4 ቢሊዮን ዶላር እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልፀው፣ በአሜሪካ የተጣለባቸውን የታሪፍ ቀረጥ በጊዜያዊነት እንዲያነሱላቸው ጠይቀዋል። ቀደም ሲል አሜሪካ በሠራተኛ መብት አያያዝ ምክንያት በኮሎምቢያ ላይ የጣለችው የንግድ ቀረጥ፣ የአገሪቱን የመልሶ ግንባታ ጥረት እንደሚያስተጓጉል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa keessatti balaa socho'iinsa lafaa cimaa mudateen lubbuun namoota 300 ol erga darbee booda, pirezidaantiin biyyattii Abelardo de la Espriella, pirezidaant Doonaald Traampitti dhiheessuudhaan gibira daldalaa (tariffs) ameerikaan irra keesse akka haqu gaafataniiru. Biyyi kun deebisanii ijaaruuf qarshii biliyoona 6.4 kan barbaadu yoo ta'u, gibirri kun immoo diinagdee biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumaa jira. Pirezidaantichi dhimma kana irratti Traamp wajjin mari'atanii kan turan yoo ta'u, yeroo rakkoo cimaa kanaan biyyattii gargaaruuf gibirichi yeroof akka dhaabbatu gaafataniiru.

title: Report: Drone strikes kill three Houthi fighters and wound commanders in southwest Yemen
english: Yemeni government forces reported that a drone attack in the southwestern Taiz region resulted in the deaths of three Houthi fighters. The strikes also caused injuries to several other individuals, including key field commanders. This operation marks another incident of ongoing military conflict in the region.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በደቡብ ምዕራብ ታኢዝ ግዛት ባደረሱት የድሮን ጥቃት ሦስት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ በርካታ ሌሎች ታጣቂዎችን እንዲሁም የቡድኑን የመስክ አዛዦች ማቁሰሉ ተገልጿል። ይህ ክስተት በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን የውትድርና ግጭት ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen naannoo Ta’izitti miidhagaa kibba-dhihaatti xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeessaniin loltoonni Huutii sadan ajjeefamuu isaanii ibsameera. Haleellaa kanaan loltoota biroo fi ajajoonni waraana qondaalonni hedduun madaa’aniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa waraanaa naannichatti itti fufee jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians in Masafer Yatta attacks
english: Israeli settlers carried out a series of attacks against Palestinians in the Masafer Yatta region of the West Bank. Five individuals, including a child and two women, sustained injuries during an assault in the village of Umm al-Khair. Additionally, settlers caused damage to private property and a vehicle while traveling through nearby areas.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ ማሳፈር ያታ አካባቢ በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። በኡም አል-ኻይር መንደር በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ህጻን እና ሁለት ሴቶችን ጨምሮ አምስት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በተጨማሪም ሰፈራ ሰሪዎቹ በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ አካባቢዎች የሰዎችን ንብረት እና ተሽከርካሪ አውድመዋል።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el naannoo Maasafer Yaataa kan jiruun Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa keessatti namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Magaalaa Umm al-Khair keessatti namoonni shan kanneen keessaa ijoolleen fi dubartoonni bakka bu'an miidhaan irra ga'eera. Kana malees, qotee bulaan kun qabeenya dhuunfaa fi konkolaataalee karaa irra turan irratti mancaatii geessisaniiru.

title: Why is the latest Ebola outbreak worsening?
english: A severe Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has resulted in 2,000 deaths. According to the World Health Organization, the virus is currently spreading more rapidly than in any prior incident, overwhelming existing control measures. Experts are working to identify the specific factors fueling this escalation and the associated public health risks.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ ሰሜናዊ ምስራቅ ክፍል የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እስካሁን 2,000 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት እንደገለጸው፣ ቫይረሱ ከቀድሞዎቹ ወረርሽኞች በበለጠ ፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ በመሆኑ የቁጥጥር ስራዎቹን እጅግ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ባለሙያዎች የበሽታውን መባባስ ምክንያቶች እና የሚያስከትለውን የጤና ስጋት ለመገምገም ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Koppa’uun dhibee Ebolaa kan kaaba-bahaa biyya Rippabiliika Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti mudate namoota 2,000 ol ajjeeseera. Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa akka ibsetti, vaayirasichi kanaan dura irra saffisaan babal'achaa waan jiruuf, to'annoo godhamaa jiru caalaa ariifatee darba jira. Ogeeyyonni sababoota dhibee kanaa fi balaa fayyaa inni geessisu sakatta'uun furmaata barbaadaa jiru.

title: Rescuers search for survivors of powerful Indonesia earthquake
english: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck the Indonesian island of Flores early Saturday, resulting in at least 47 deaths and significant destruction. Rescue teams are currently working to locate survivors among the rubble of hundreds of damaged homes and public buildings across remote, mountainous areas. The government is actively delivering emergency aid packages, though officials expect it will take time to fully understand the scope of the disaster due to the difficult terrain and ongoing aftershocks.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በኢንዶኔዥያ ፍሎሬስ ደሴት ላይ የደረሰው የ7.7 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 47 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን ከፍተኛ ውድመትም አስከትሏል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በከተሞች እና በገጠር አካባቢዎች የፈራረሱ ቤቶችንና ህንጻዎችን በመፈተሽ የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። መንግስት አስቸኳይ እርዳታዎችን ወደ አካባቢው እየላከ ቢሆንም፣ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የደረሰውን አጠቃላይ ጉዳት ለማጣራት አስቸጋሪ በሆነው የመሬት አቀማመጥ ምክንያት ጊዜ እንደሚወስድ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Dilbata ganama bahaa, buqee lafaa cimaan 7.7 magnitude qabu kutaalee Indoneezhiyaa keessa kan jirtu odoola Flores irratti mudatee lubbuun namoota 47 ol darbeera. Gareewwan fayyisootaafi gargaarsa namoomaa, gamoonniifi manneen hedduun caccabuu isaanii hordofee lubbuu namoota jiran barbaacha irratti argamu. Mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa erguu kan eegale yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan kutaalee sanaa tulluuwwan kan qabaniifi iddoo ulfaataa waan ta'aniif miidhaan guutuu inni geessise maal akka fakkaatu beekuuf yeroo fudhata jedhamee eegama.

title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
english: Iran has requested the release of three of its pilots, claiming they have been held by Qatar for six months following a combat mission during the ongoing war. Qatar has firmly denied these allegations, stating that the pilots are not in their custody and that they have already fulfilled their duties by searching for the airmen and returning the remains of a fourth pilot. Qatari officials maintain they acted in self-defense when the aircraft entered their airspace and have urged Iran to engage in official coordination regarding the rescue findings.
amharic: ኢራን በጦርነቱ ወቅት በአየር ላይ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሶስት አብራሪዎቿ በኳታር ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል በማለት እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቃለች። ኳታር ይህንን ክስ አጥብቃ በመካድ አብራሪዎቹ በእጃቸው እንደሌሉ እና ቀደም ሲል የፍለጋ ስራ በማከናወን የአራተኛውን አብራሪ አስከሬን መመለሳቸውን አስታውቃለች። የኳታር መንግስት ድርጊታቸው የአገራቸውን ሉዓላዊነት ለመከላከል የተወሰደ ህጋዊ እርምጃ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ኢራን በጉዳዩ ላይ በይፋዊ መንገድ እንድትወያይ ጠይቋል።
oromo: Iraan waraana ammaa keessatti xiyyaarri ishee lachuun rukutamanii, pilaayonni ishee sadii Qaxar harkatti akka qabaman ibsuun akka gadhiifaman gaafatteetti. Qaxar himata kana guutummaatti kan haalte yoo ta'u, pilaayonni kunneen harka isaanii akka hin jirre fi pilaayota arfaffaa du'e reeffa isaa kennuu isaanii ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Qaxar, tarkaanfiin fudhatame biyya isaanii of irraa ittisuuf kan fudhatame ta'uu fi Iraan gabaasa barbaacha isaa irratti marii akka taatu gaafatteetti.

title: Qatar denies it is detaining three Iranian bomber pilots
english: Qatar has officially rejected Iran’s allegations that it is secretly holding three Iranian pilots captured after their planes were shot down in March. While Iran claims the pilots are being detained without communication, Qatar insists that only the body of one deceased pilot was recovered and returned. Qatari officials stated these claims are misleading and emphasized that no surviving aircrew members are in their custody.
amharic: ኳታር በአውሮፕላኖቻቸው መመታትን ተከትሎ ሶስት የኢራን አብራሪዎችን በድብቅ ይዛለች የሚለውን የኢራን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። ኢራን አብራሪዎቹ በቁጥጥር ስር እንደሆኑ ብትገልጽም፣ ኳታር ግን የተገኘው የአንድ የሞተ አብራሪ አስከሬን ብቻ እንደሆነ እና ለኢራን እንደተረከበች አስታውቃለች። የኳታር ባለስልጣናት የኢራን መግለጫ ሀሰተኛ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ምንም አይነት ህያው አብራሪ በቁጥጥራቸው ስር እንደሌለ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Qatar himata Iran kan isheen qajeelatoota xiyyaaraa sadii qabattee hidheetti jirti jedhu haalteetti. Iran qajeelatoonni kun bakka hin beekamneetti hidhamanii jiru jechuun himattuus, Qatar garuu reeffa qajeelataa tokko qofa argachuu fi of eeggannoodhaan Iranitti deebisuu ishee ibsiteetti. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Qatar himanni kun dhugaa irraa fagaachuu isaa fi qajeelatoonni lubbuun jiran harka isaanii akka hin jirre mirkaneessaniiru.

title: California tackles multiple wildfires as firefighter workforce faces strain
english: California is struggling to control several large wildfires, including the significant Timber Fire in Big Sur and the massive Bug Fire near the Nevada border. These blazes have caused widespread evacuations and continue to spread due to hot, dry, and windy conditions. Meanwhile, firefighting crews are facing extreme pressure due to both the intensity of the climate-driven fires and recent federal budget cuts that have reduced their resources.
amharic: ካሊፎርኒያ በቢግ ሱር አካባቢ የተነሳውን የቲምበር እሳት እና በኔቫዳ ድንበር አቅራቢያ የሚገኘውን ትልቅ የቡግ እሳትን ጨምሮ በርካታ የዱር እሳቶችን ለመቆጣጠር እየታገለች ነው። እነዚህ የእሳት አደጋዎች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እንዲፈናቀሉ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በደረቅ እና ነፋሻማ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት እየተባባሱ ይገኛሉ። በሌላ በኩል፣ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ሠራተኞች በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት በሚባባሱ ትላልቅ እሳቶች እና በፌዴራል በጀት ቅነሳ ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Kaalifoorniyaan ibidda bosonaa hedduu, kanneen akka ibidda 'Timber' naannoo Biig Sur fi ibidda guddaa 'Bug' daangaa Nivaadaa irratti argamu to'achuuf qabsoo cimaa gochaa jirti. Ibiddoonni kun namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawaman mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera, akkasumas haala qilleensa goginsaafi qilleensa cimaa kanaan walqabatee babal'achaa jiru. Gama biraatiin, hojjettoonni dhaamsuu ibiddaa jijjiirama qilleensaafi hanqina baajata mootummaa federaalaatiin walqabatee hojii baay'ee cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Canadian petition to expel US ambassador gains over 170,000 signatures
english: A Canadian petition calling for the expulsion of US Ambassador Pete Hoekstra has received over 170,000 signatures, far exceeding the requirement for a formal parliamentary review. Supporters claim Hoekstra has damaged diplomatic relations by making provocative statements and allegedly interfering in domestic politics. The petition demands that Canada officially declare the ambassador persona non grata and investigate the nature of US diplomatic conduct within the country.
amharic: የካናዳ የአሜሪካ አምባሳደር ፒት ሆክስትራ እንዲባረሩ የሚጠይቅ አቤቱታ ከ170,000 በላይ ፊርማዎችን በማሰባሰብ የፓርላማ ውይይት እንዲደረግበት የሚያስፈልገውን መስፈርት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አልፏል። አቤቱታ አቅራቢዎቹ አምባሳደሩ ተገቢ ያልሆኑ ንግግሮችን በመናገር እና በካናዳ የውስጥ ጉዳይ ጣልቃ በመግባት የሁለቱን አገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እንደጎዱ ይከራከራሉ። አቤቱታው መንግስት አምባሳደሩን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያስወግድ እና በአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማቶች የፖለቲካ ጣልቃ ገብነት ላይ ምርመራ እንዲያደርግ ይጠይቃል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Kaanaadaa jiraan, Piit Hookistaraan biyyattii gadhiisanii akka bahan kan gaafatu mallattoon ummataa 170,000 ol ta’e walitti qabameera. Namoonni mallatteessan kun, ambaasaaddarichi haasaa madaqina hin qabne dubbachuun fi dhimma keessoo biyyattii keessa galuun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii miidheera jedhu. Mallattoon kun mootummaan Kaanaadaa ambaasaaddaricha akka irratti tarkaanfii fudhatuu fi dhiibbaa Ameerikaan dhimma biyya keessaa irratti gootu qulqulleessuuf gaafata.

title: Moroccan Police Intercept Migrants Heading for Ceuta Enclave
english: Moroccan security forces have increased their presence in Fnideq to stop migrants from entering the Spanish territory of Ceuta. The deployment of additional personnel along the Tarajal border area has effectively prevented illegal crossings. Authorities have successfully restored order to the region following recent attempts by migrants to reach the enclave.

oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Morookoo godaantonni gara daangaa biyya Ispeen kan taate Se'utaatti akka hin ceene ittisuuf naannoo Fiindeqitti hojiiwwan isaanii cimsuudha. Humnoonni nageenyaa dabalataa daangaa Taaraajaal irratti bobba'an karaa seeraan alaa gara biyyattii seenuu barbaadan dhaabuun nagaa deebisaniiru. Bulchiinsi biyyattii yaalii godaantonni gara daangaa sanaatti ce'uuf godhan to'annoo jala oolchuu danda'aniiru.

title: Iran condemns Israeli attacks in Lebanon
english: Iran has officially denounced recent Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon that resulted in the deaths of 11 people, including children. A government spokesperson criticized the United Nations for failing to intervene against these violations of international law. Tehran expressed strong support for Lebanon's sovereignty following these incidents, which represent the most severe violence since a ceasefire framework was established in June.
amharic: ኢራን በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ 11 ሰዎችን የገደለውን የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በጽኑ አውግዛለች። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት በህገ-ወጥ ድርጊቱ ላይ ዝምታ መምረጡን ነቅፈዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ባለፈው ሰኔ ወር ከተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ እጅግ አሳሳቢው መሆኑ የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ኢራንም የሊባኖስን ሉዓላዊነት እንደምትደግፍ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Iraan, kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa xiyyaaraan Israa'el raawwatteefi daa'imman dabalatee namoota 11 ajjeese kana balaaleffatteetti. Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan, Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniifi mana maree nageenyaa isaanii badii kana irratti callisuu isaaniitiin qeequu isaanii ibsameera. Haleellaan kun guyyaa ji'a Waxabajjii irraa jalqabee walii galtee waraana dhaabuu booda kan raawwatameefi yeroo hunda caalaa kan cimaa dhufe yoo ta'u, Iraanis bilisummaa Libaanoos cinaa dhaabbachuu ishee ibsiteetti.

title: Moroccan police arrest over 100 migrants trying to reach Spanish enclave
english: Moroccan security forces have apprehended over 100 individuals attempting to enter the Spanish territory of Ceuta. These crowds were reportedly mobilized by a deceptive social media campaign encouraging migration through dangerous mountainous routes. Authorities used tear gas to manage the situation as tensions remain high following a previous mass migration event in the region.
amharic: የሞሮኮ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሱዌታ ለመግባት የሞከሩ ከ100 በላይ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እነዚህ ሰዎች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በተሰራጨ የተሳሳተ መረጃ ተገፋፍተው በአደገኛ የተራራ መንገድ ለመጓዝ ሞክረዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ህዝቡን ለመበተን የለቅሶ ጋዝ የተጠቀሙ ሲሆን፣ አካባቢው ባለፈው ወር በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የፍልሰት እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Morookoo namoota 100 ol kan ta'an gara daangaa Ispeen Se'uta (Ceuta) seenuuf yaalanii turan to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Namoonni kunneen duula odeeffannoo sobaa miidiyaalee hawaasaarratti gaggeeffameen kaka'anii karaa gaarreenii fi miidhaa guddaa qabuun daangaa ce'uuf yaalan. Bulchiinsi biyyattii walitti qamama kana bittinneessuuf gaazii imimmaansuu kan fayyadaman yoo ta'u, kanaan dura godaansi guddaan mudachuu isaatiin wal-qabatee naannichi amma ammayyuu tasgabbii dhabee jira.

title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
english: Liechtenstein has updated its royal succession laws to enable women to inherit the throne, moving from a male-only priority system to one based on birth order regardless of gender. This amendment will apply to the descendants of Hereditary Prince Alois's children rather than the current line of succession. The royal family stated that this shift aims to ensure that future leaders are chosen based on their qualifications for the role.
amharic: የሊችተንስታይን ንጉሳዊ ቤተሰብ ሴቶች የዙፋኑ ወራሽ እንዲሆኑ የሚያስችል አዲስ ህግ አስተዋውቋል። ከዚህ በኋላ የሚደረገው የዙፋን ውርስ የልጆችን የትውልድ ቅደም ተከተል ብቻ መሰረት የሚያደርግ ይሆናል። ይህ ለውጥ አሁን ያለውን የዙፋን ቅደም ተከተል የማይነካ ሲሆን፣ ከወራሹ ልጆች ለሚወለዱት ተተኪዎች ብቻ ተግባራዊ የሚሆን ነው።
oromo: Biyyi Liichtenstaayin jedhamtu seera itti fayyadama aangoo mootummaa ishee kan yeroo durii dhiiraaf qofa ta’e geeddaruun dubartoonnis akka mooti ta’uu danda’an taasisteetti. Jijjiiramni kun gara fuulduraatti ijoollee ilmi mootichaa Aloos argatan irratti kan hojii irra oolu ta’ee, kaayyoon isaas namni madaalawaa ta’e akka biyya bulchuufi.

title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta
english: Moroccan security forces detained over 100 migrants near the border town of Fnideq as they attempted to enter the Spanish exclave of Ceuta. Authorities heavily reinforced the area with troops, drones, and naval vessels following viral social media posts that encouraged a mass crossing attempt. This operation follows a recent surge in migration activity that has heightened security and diplomatic tensions in the region.
amharic: የሞሮኮ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ለመግባት የሞከሩ ከ100 በላይ ስደተኞችን በድንበር አካባቢ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በሶሻል ሚዲያ በተሰራጩ ጥሪዎች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ሰዎች ድንበር ለመሻገር መሞከራቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን በወታደሮች፣ በድሮኖች እና በባህር ኃይል አጠናክረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በቅርቡ በተፈጠረው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት በክልሉ የተፈጠረውን የጸጥታ ውጥረት ተከትሎ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Morookkoo godaantota 100 ol ta'an kanneen gara daangaa Ispeen Se'utaatti ce'uuf yaalii godhan naannoo Fnideqitti to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Namoonni hedduun miidiyaa hawaasaarratti waamicha godhame hordofuudhaan daangaa ce'uuf yaaluun isaanii erga beekamee booda, mootummaan humna waraanaa, dooniiwwan waraanaa fi dirooniin daangichaa akka jabaatu godheera. Tarkaanfiin kun godaantota hedduu daangaa ce'uuf yaalaniin walqabatee rakkoon nageenyaa fi siyaasaa naannichatti uumame kan itti fufe dha.

title: Death toll from Zimbabwe ferry disaster rises to 69
english: The death toll from a ferry sinking on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has climbed to 69 after 23 additional bodies were recovered. Authorities believe the vessel, which was carrying over 150 people despite an official limit of 90, overturned due to severe weather and overloading. The government has declared a national disaster, as the tragedy has devastated local communities that relied on the ferry for essential supplies.
amharic: በዚምባብዌ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ የሰመጠው የጀልባ አደጋ ሰለባዎች ቁጥር ተጨማሪ 23 አስከሬኖች በመገኘታቸው ወደ 69 ከፍ ብሏል። 90 ሰው የመጫን አቅም ብቻ የነበራት ጀልባ ከ150 በላይ ሰዎችን ጭና በመጓዟ እና በጠንካራ ንፋስ ምክንያት እንደገለበጠች ተጠቁሟል። መንግሥት አደጋውን ብሔራዊ የጥፋት ቀናት በማለት አውጆ፣ በአካባቢው ለሚገኙ ማህበረሰቦች አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Zimbaabwee keessatti markabni haroo Kaariibaa keessatti gubate kun lubbuu namoota 69 galaafateera. Markabichi namoota 90 qofa fe'uu kan danda'u ta'us, namoota 150 ol fe'ee imala isaa jalqabuun isaa fi bubbeen cimaan mudachuu isaatiin ajaja isaa akka dhabe ibsameera. Mootummaan balaa kana akka balaa biyyoolessaatti kan labse yoo ta'u, uummata miidhameef gargaarsa gochuuf duula eegaleera.

title: Israel says soldiers wounded in southern Lebanon
english: Three Israeli soldiers, including an officer, were injured following a drone explosion in southern Lebanon during the night. The military confirmed that the wounded personnel have been evacuated to a hospital for medical care. The soldiers' families have already been informed of the incident.

oromo: Halkan darbue kibba Libaanoositti weerara xiyyaara nama malee (drone) kanaan loltoonni Israa'el saddeet, isaan keessaa ajajaan tokko, miidhamaniiru. Loltoonni miidhaman kun yaalaaf gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru akkasumas maatiin isaanii waa'ee haalicha akka beekan ta'eera.

title: La Liga: Real Madrid key talking points heading into new 2026-27 season
english: Real Madrid has reappointed Jose Mourinho as head coach following two seasons without a major trophy. The team has significantly bolstered its defensive roster with new signings while retaining star offensive players like Kylian Mbappe and Jude Bellingham. The club aims to regain its dominant position in La Liga and the Champions League, hoping Mourinho’s disciplined approach can prevent rival Barcelona from winning a third consecutive league title.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ ምንም አይነት ዋንጫ ሳይበላ ሁለት ዓመታት ካሳለፈ በኋላ ሆዜ ሞሪንሆ በአሰልጣኝነት እንዲመለሱ አድርጓል። ክለቡ የተከላካይ መስመሩን ለማጠናከር አዳዲስ ተጫዋቾችን የጨመረ ሲሆን እንደ ካይሊያን ምባፔ እና ጁድ ቤሊንግሃም ያሉ ኮከብ አጥቂዎችንም ይዞ ቀጥሏል። ማድሪድ በላ ሊጋ እና በሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ የበላይነቱን ለመመለስ የሚፈልግ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም ባርሴሎና ሶስተኛ የሊግ ዋንጫውን እንዳያገኝ የሞሪንሆ ተግሣጽ የተሞላበት የጨዋታ ስልት ይረዳቸዋል ተብሎ ይታመናል።
oromo: Real Madrid waggoota lama waancaa malee dabarsuun booda Jose Mourinho gara leenjistummaa akka deebi'an taasiseera. Gareen kun ittisa isaanii cimsuuf taphattoota haaraa kan filatan yoo ta'u, taphattoota olaanoo akka Kylian Mbappe fi Jude Bellingham waliin itti fufuuf murteessaniiru. Real Madrid dorgommii La Liga fi Champions League irratti injifannoo argachuuf kan karoorfate yoo ta'u, mala Mourinho kan cimina irratti xiyyeeffatuun Barcelona waancaa sadaffaa akka hin fudhanne dhaabuuf yaadameera.

title: Cleanup underway as Russian oil spill reaches Oman’s coastline
english: Cleanup teams are working to remove an oil spill that has contaminated 12 kilometers of Oman's coastline. The spill originated from a grounded tanker carrying 800,000 barrels of Russian crude oil. Because the accident happened near a marine reserve, there are significant concerns regarding potential long-term environmental damage to the area.

oromo: Buufata doonii Omaanitti dhangala'aa boba'aa harca'e qulqulleessuuf hojiin eegalameera. Balaan kun kan uumame doonii boba'aa Ruusiyaa kuma 800 fe'attee imalaa turtee fi qarqara galaanaatti rukutamtee dha. title: US aircraft carrier expected to relieve USS Lincoln in Middle East
english: The USS George Washington has departed from Vietnam, with reports suggesting it will replace the USS Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East. The USS Lincoln has been at sea for a record-breaking 266 days, leading to significant concerns regarding crew mental health, food shortages, and poor living conditions. While the Pentagon has not officially confirmed the rotation, the move follows mounting pressure from lawmakers to address the well-being of the 5,000 personnel on board the Lincoln.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር መርከብ ዩኤስኤስ ጆርጅ ዋሽንግተን በቅርቡ ከቬትናም በመነሳት ወደ መካከለኛው ምስራቅ እያመራ እንደሆነ ተዘግቧል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ለረጅም ጊዜ በውጊያ ላይ የቆየችውን እና በሠራተኞቹ ላይ የአእምሮ ጤና እና የአቅርቦት ችግሮች እንዳጋጠሟት የተነገረላትን ዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከንን ለመተካት ነው። ምንም እንኳን የፔንታጎን ጉዳዩን በይፋ ባያረጋግጥም፣ የሊንከን መርከብ ሰራተኞች ለረጅም ጊዜ በባህር ላይ በመቆየታቸው በአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ዘንድ ትልቅ ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Dooniin waraana Ameerikaa USS George Washington jedhamtu Vietnam gadhiistee gara Baha Giddu galeessaatti imalaa akka jirtu gabaasameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame doonii USS Abraham Lincoln, kan yeroo dheeraaf bakka tokko turte fi rakkoolee fayyaa sammuu akkasumas hanqina nyaataa fi qulqullinaa irratti mudatan bakka buusuufi. Pentagoniin gadi fageenyaan waan dubbate hin jiru ta'us, dooniin Lincoln ji'oota hedduuf bahara keessa turuun ishee qaamolee mootummaa biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee ture.

title: Inter Milan sign England’s Djed Spence from Tottenham Hotspur
english: Inter Milan has officially acquired English wing-back Djed Spence from Tottenham Hotspur on a five-year contract. The 26-year-old defender, who previously won the Europa League with Spurs, moved to the Italian champions in a deal reportedly worth around $40 million. Spence joins the Serie A side following a four-year stint in North London and recent international experience with England at the 2026 World Cup.
amharic: ኢንተር ሚላን የ26 ዓመቱን እንግሊዛዊ ተከላካይ ጄድ ስፔንስን ከቶተንሃም ሆትስፐር በአምስት ዓመት ውል አስፈርሟል። የጣሊያኑ ሻምፒዮን ለተጫዋቹ ዝውውር ወደ 40 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ገደማ እንደከፈለ ተዘግቧል። ስፔንስ በለንደን ቆይታው የዩሮፓ ሊግ ዋንጫን ያነሳ ሲሆን፣ አሁን ደግሞ በሴሪ አው በኢንተር ሚላን ቀጣይ የሙያ ዘመኑን ያሳልፋል።
oromo: Inter Milan taphataa ittisaa Ingilizii Djed Spence taphataa Tottenham Hotspur irraa waggaa shaniif ofitti makatteetti. Gochaan kun kan raawwate qabiinsa kan kaffaltii doolaara miliyoona 40 ta'uun akka gabaasameetti. Djed Spence yeroo isaa Tottenhamitti dabarseen booda, amma gara liigii Xaaliyaanii Serie A itti darbee taphachuuf qophaa'eera.

title: Tropical Storm Lala expected to strengthen as it nears Hawaii
english: Tropical Storm Lala is heading toward Hawaii and is expected to intensify into a hurricane before reaching the Big Island. Authorities have issued warnings for severe weather, including heavy rainfall, flash flooding, and damaging winds that could cause significant hazards. Residents are being urged to finalize their safety preparations and remain sheltered as the storm impacts the region throughout the weekend.
amharic: ሐوایی በትሮፒካል አውሎ ንፋስ ላላ ስጋት ውስጥ ትገኛለች፤ አውሎ ንፋሱ ወደ ሀሪኬንነት እንደሚቀየር ተገምቷል። ባለስልጣናት በከባድ ዝናብ፣ በጎርፍ አደጋ እና በኃይለኛ ነፋስ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲደረግ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ነዋሪዎች የቅድመ ዝግጅት ስራዎቻቸውን እንዲያጠናቅቁ እና በቤት ውስጥ እንዲቆዩ ተመክረዋል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Lala jedhamu gara Hawaii qajeele jiraachuu isaa fi gara obomboleettii cimaatti jijjiiramuu danda'a jedhamee eegama. Aangeyyoonni rooba cimaa, lolaa fi qilleensa humna guddaa qabuun miidhaa geessisuu danda'uuf akeekkachiisa dabarsaniiru. Jiraattonni qophii isaanii akka xumuranii fi obomboleettichi haga darbutti mana keessa akka turan gorfamaniiru.

title: Israeli army says it killed two Palestinians in Gaza
english: The Israeli military reported that its soldiers shot and killed two Palestinians who crossed a restricted boundary known as the yellow line. Reports indicate that Israel is expanding this buffer zone deeper into Gaza, which has led to the further displacement of local residents. This ongoing strategy has intensified the siege, forcing a massive civilian population into an ever-shrinking area of the territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በጋዛ 'ቢጫ መስመር' ተብሎ የሚጠራውን የተከለከለ ክልል ጥሰው የገቡ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያንን መግደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እስራኤል ይህንን የመከላከያ መስመር ወደ ውስጥ በማስፋቷ ብዙ ፍልስጤማውያን መፈናቀላቸውን ዘገባዎች ያመለክታሉ። ይህ ድርጊት በጋዛ የሚገኙ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን በአንድ ጠባብ ቦታ ውስጥ በመጨፍለቅ ጫናውን የበለጠ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el namoota Palastinuu lama daangaa 'sarara keelloo' jedhamu darban tarkaanfii fudhateen ajjeesuusaa beeksiseera. Israa'el sarara kana gara keessa gadi fageessuun lafa qabachuu isheen maatiin Palastinuu hedduun akka buqqa'an gabaafameera. Tooftaan kun namoota miliyoona lama ol ta'an lafa dhiphoo taate keessatti walitti qabuun muddamaafi dhiphina uummataarra jiru caalaatti hammeesseera.

title: UK PM Burnham reacts to death of former Cambridge professor
english: Jason Arday, the youngest Black professor ever appointed at Cambridge University, has died at age 41 following intense public scrutiny regarding his academic background. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham described the situation as a tragedy and called for national reflection rather than premature judgment. While police report the death is not suspicious, many activists and public figures are criticizing the intense media pressure and alleged lack of institutional support that preceded his passing.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ታናሽ ጥቁር ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩት ጄሰን አርዳይ በ41 ዓመታቸው በድንገት ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። አርዳይ የትምህርት ዝግጅታቸውን በተመለከተ ከፍተኛ የሚዲያ እና የህዝብ ትችት ሲቀርብባቸው ነበር። የእንግሊዝ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የሟች መሞት አሳዛኝ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ጉዳዩን በፍጥነት ከመፍረድ ይልቅ በጥልቀት ማሰብ እንደሚያስፈልግ ተናግረዋል። አንዳንዶች በሃገሪቱ የሚዲያ ተቋማት እና በዩኒቨርሲቲው በኩል በአርዳይ ላይ የተፈጸመው ጫና ለሞታቸው አስተዋጽኦ እንዳደረገ በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን እየገለጹ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirofesara gurraacha ganna 41 kan ta'an fi Yunivarsitii Kaambrijii keessatti bakka guddaa qabatanii turan Jeeson Ardaay du'aan boqotaniiru. Ardaay bu'aa barnoota isaanii irratti miidiyaalee fi hawaasa biraa qeeqa cimaa irratti ka'aa ture. Ministirri Muummee Biritish Andii Barnhaam du'a isaanii akka balaa cimaatti ibsanii, yeroon kun kan itti wal-qeequ osoo hin taane kan itti yaadanu ta'uu hubachiisaniiru. Namoonni hedduun ammoo dhiibbaan miidiyaalee fi hanqinni deeggarsa dhaabbata barnootaa isaanirra ga'aa ture du'a isaaniif sababa ta'uu mala jechuun komachaa jiru.

title: Iran resumes flights at Bandar Abbas airport after wartime disruptions
english: Bandar Abbas International Airport has officially restarted scheduled domestic flights following several closures caused by the ongoing conflict with the United States. Passengers can now book travel to and from major cities including Tehran, Mashhad, and Isfahan. Officials confirmed that this move marks a return to more regular operations after a period of limited travel availability.
amharic: ከአሜሪካ ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት ምክንያት ተቋርጠው የነበሩ የባንዳር አባስ ዓለም አቀፍ አየር ማረፊያ በረራዎች እንደገና ተጀምረዋል። ተጓዦች አሁን ከቴህራን፣ ከመሻድ እና ከኢስፋሃን ከተሞች ወደ ባንዳር አባስ እና ወደ ተለያዩ አቅጣጫዎች የሚደረጉ የሀገር ውስጥ በረራዎችን መጠቀም ይችላሉ። የአየር ማረፊያው ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰኑ በረራዎች ብቻ ይደረጉበት ከነበረበት ጊዜ ወዲህ ወደ መደበኛ አገልግሎት ለመመለስ የተደረገ ጥረት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Buufanni xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa Bandar Abbas waraana Ameerikaa wajjin jiruun walqabatee addaan cite ture ergaa qulqulleeffamee booda deebi'ee banameera. Amma imaltoonni gara magaalaalee guddoo kanneen akka Tehran, Mashhad fi Isfahan akkasumas gara Bandar Abbasitti balaliiwwan keessa biyyaa fayyadamuu danda'u. Hojjettoonni buufata xiyyaaraa akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin kun yeroo balaliin daangeeffamee ture booda gara tajaajila idileetti deebi'uuf kan taasifame dha.

title: Opinion: How Iran and Ukraine are strategically sinking their rivals at sea
english: While the conflict involving Iran often centers on air operations, the most significant strategic consequences are currently unfolding at sea. Despite potential U.S. military escalations, such as targeting critical infrastructure or nuclear facilities, these actions are unlikely to dismantle Iran's established maritime presence. Consequently, the Strait of Hormuz remains a central and uncontrollable focal point in this ongoing regional struggle.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን የኢራን ግጭት በአብዛኛው በአየር ጥቃት ላይ ያተኮረ ቢመስልም፣ ዋናው ስልታዊ ውጤቱ ግን በባህር ላይ እየተወሰነ ይገኛል። አሜሪካ በኢራን ወሳኝ መሠረተ ልማቶች ወይም በኑክሌር ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት ብትሰነዝርም፣ የኢራንን የባህር ኃይል አቅም ሙሉ ለሙሉ ለማዳከም አትችልም። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ ሆርሙዝ የባህር ስትራቴጂያዊ ጠቀሜታው ሳይቀንስ በግጭቱ ማዕከልነት ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Gonkomaan Iran waraana qilleensa irraatti xiyyeeffatu fakkaatuus, bu’aan isaa inni guddaan garuu galaana irratti murtaa’aa jira. Yeroo ammaa mootummaan Ameerikaa buufataalee Iran irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf karoorsituus, kunis ta’e gama biraa carraaqqiiwwan jiran dhiibbaa Iran galaana irra qabdu guutummaatti hir’isuu hin danda’an. Kanaafuu, dhiphinnii Hormuz akkaataa waraana kanaan walqabatee iddoo xiyyeeffannoo gurguddoo ta’ee itti fufa.

title: Iran says route through Hormuz agreed with Oman, but deal yet to be finalised
english: Iran and Oman have established a preliminary roadmap for shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz. Although an agreement has been reached to ensure safer vessel passage, both nations are still finalizing specific details and a formal joint statement. This cooperation aims to maintain maritime security while respecting regional sovereignty, despite reported interference from the United States.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል የሚደረገውን የባህር ጉዞ ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ የሚያስችል የመጀመሪያ ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት የመርከብ መስመሮችን በጋራ ለማስተዳደር ተስማምተው ዝርዝር ጉዳዮች ላይ እየተወያዩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ስምምነት የአሜሪካን ተፅዕኖ ተቋቁሞ፣ የሁለቱን ሀገራት ሉዓላዊነት በመጠበቅ በክልሉ የባህር ላይ ደህንነትን ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaanni karaa markabootni Itticha Hormuz keessa darban irratti walii galtee jalqabaa irra ga'aniiru. Biyyoonni lamaan kun nageenya karaa bishaanichaarratti qindeessuuf waliigalticha kan godhan yoo ta'u, dhimmoota biroo kan akka ibsa waloo baasuurratti mariin itti fufee jira. Waliigalteen kun dhiibbaa Ameerikaa utuu hin hirdhin, kabaja biyyoota lamaanii eeguun nageenya galaana irratti mirkaneessuuf kan qophaaye dha.

title: Yemen's Mocha port suspends operations after Houthi attacks
english: The port of Mocha in Yemen has halted all commercial and shipping activities following a series of intense Houthi missile strikes. These attacks resulted in the deaths of seven individuals and caused physical and financial damage estimated at $16 million. Port officials announced the closure on Saturday as a direct response to the recent onslaught.
amharic: የየመን የሞቻ ወደብ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመው ተከታታይ የሮኬት ጥቃት ምክንያት የንግድ እና የባህር ጉዞ ስራዎቹን አቋርጧል። በጥቃቱ ሰባት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ወደብ ላይ የ16 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የንብረት ውድመት ደርሷል። የባህር ወደቡ ዳይሬክተር እንዳስታወቁት፣ ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ከ25 በላይ ሚሳይሎች ወደብ ላይ ከተተኮሱ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Buufanni doonii Mochaa kan Yaman, haleellaa rokketii garee Huutii irra gaheen walqabatee hojii isaa dhaabeera. Haleellaa kana keessatti namoonni torba yoo du'an, miidhaan qabeenyaa doolaara miliyoona 16 tilmaamamu mudateera. Hojjettoonni buufatichaa akka ibsanitti, guyyoota darban keessa rokkeetii 25 ol buufaticha rukutuun isaa hojii dhaabuuf dirqisiiseera.

title: Erdogan says Egypt could join Turkiye-Saudi-Pakistan defence pact
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has suggested that Egypt may eventually join the newly formed Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, which currently includes Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan. This pact functions as a collective security framework where an attack on one member is considered an attack on all. In a recent interview, Erdogan emphasized the agreement's importance for regional stability and expressed his commitment to supporting peace efforts in Syria, Gaza, and Lebanon.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶኻን ግብፅ በቅርቡ በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል በተፈረመው የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ውስጥ ልትቀላቀል እንደምትችል ገልጸዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ አባል ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ የሚቆጥር የጋራ ደህንነት ጥበቃ ስርዓት ነው። ኤርዶኻን በቅርቡ በሰጡት ቃለ-መጠይቅ ስምምነቱ ለክልሉ መረጋጋት ያለውን ፋይዳ በመጠቆም፣ በሶሪያ፣ በጋዛ እና በሊባኖስ ለሚደረጉ የሰላም ጥረቶች ያላቸውን ድጋፍ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Turkii Recep Tayyip Erdogan akka jedhanitti, biyyi Gibtsi waliigaltee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan yeroo dhiyoo kana biyyoota Turkii, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame kan 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement' jedhamu irratti makamuu dandeessi. Waliigalteen kun biyyoota miseensa ta'an keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, akka haleellaa waliiniitti kan ilaalamu dha. Erdogan miidiyaatti akka himanitti, waliigalteen kun nageenya naannichaa eeguuf barbaachisaa dha; akkasumas Syria, Gaza fi Lebanon keessatti tattaaffii nageenyaa deggeruuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: One killed, dozens injured after wildfire hits Croatian coast
english: A destructive wildfire has struck a coastal town in Croatia, resulting in one fatality and leaving over 40 people injured. Emergency responders successfully evacuated nearly 200 residents from the area. Prime Minister Andrej Plenković described the disaster as one of the most severe fire incidents the country has experienced in recent memory.
amharic: በክሮኤሺያ የባህር ዳርቻ ከተማ በተነሳ አውዳሚ የዱር እሳት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ከ40 በላይ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ወደ 200 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ከስፍራው ማዳን ችለዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንድሬይ ፕለንኮቪች ይህንን አደጋ በቅርብ ዓመታት ውስጥ ከተከሰቱት እጅግ አስከፊ የእሳት አደጋዎች አንዱ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Magalaalee qarqara galaana Krooshiyaa keessatti ibidda bosonaa cimaa mudateen namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni 40 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Ogeeyyonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa namoota 200 ta'an bakka balaan sun itti mudate irraa lubbuun oolchaniiru. Ministirri Muummee Andrej Plenković balaa kana waggoota dhihoo keessa biyyattitti mudate keessaa isa hamaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Sudan’s al-Burhan pledges immunity for dialogue, rules out Hemedti return
english: Sudanese leader Abdel Fattah al-Burhan has promised temporary legal immunity to participants joining a new independent national dialogue. He emphasized that this is not a permanent pardon, but a way to ensure people can speak freely without fear of prosecution. While he remains open to serious peace efforts, he firmly rejected any deal that would allow Hemedti and his Rapid Support Forces to return to power.
amharic: የሱዳኑ መሪ አብደል ፋታህ አል-ቡርሃን በአገር አቀፍ የውይይት መድረክ ላይ ለሚሳተፉ ግለሰቦች ጊዜያዊ የህግ ከለላ እንደሚሰጡ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ሙሉ ይቅርታ ሳይሆን፣ ተሳታፊዎች ያለ ምንም ፍርሃት አስተያየታቸውን እንዲሰጡ ለማስቻል የታለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም አል-ቡርሃን ለሰላም ድርድር ዝግጁ ቢሆኑም፣ ሄሜቲ እና የራፒድ ሰፖርት ኃይሎች ወደ ስልጣን የሚመለሱበትን ማንኛውንም ስምምነት እንደማይቀበሉ በግልጽ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Sudaan Abdulfattah Al-Burhaan, marii biyyoolessaa gaggeeffamu irratti hirmaattotaaf ittisa seeraa yeroo gabaabaa akka kennan waadaa galaniiru. Tarkanfiin kun dhiifama dhaabbataa osoo hin taane, namoonni sodaa tokko malee yaada isaanii akka ibsatan kan gargaaru dha jedhaniiru. Al-Burhaan marii nagaaf fedhii kan qaban ta'us, Hemedtii fi waraanni isaa (RSF) gara aangootti kan deebi'an ta'e garuu fudhatama akka hin qabne ibsaniiru.

title: Ukraine hits Russian Starlink-style network, Moscow tracks arms package
english: Ukraine recently launched long-range strikes deep into Russian territory, using domestically made Flamingo missiles to target a rocket facility and an air base. These attacks aim to weaken Russia's military infrastructure and its satellite internet capabilities. Simultaneously, Russia is questioning the United States and Turkey regarding reports of a significant transfer of American weapons to Ukraine.
amharic: ዩክሬን በቅርቡ በራሷ ሀገር በተመረቱ የፍላሚንጎ ሚሳኤሎች በመጠቀም በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ ጥልቅ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽማለች። ጥቃቶቹ የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ መሠረተ ልማት እና የሳተላይት ኢንተርኔት አቅምን ለማዳከም ያለሙ ናቸው። በሌላ በኩል ሩሲያ ከአሜሪካ ወደ ዩክሬን የሚደረግ ትልቅ የጦር መሳሪያ ዝውውር መኖሩን አስመልክቶ ከአሜሪካ እና ከቱርክ ማብራሪያ እየጠየቀች ነው።
oromo: Yukreeniin yeroo dhihoo asitti meeshaa waraanaa biyya keessatti omishtee fayyadamuun, xiyyaara 'Flamingo' jedhamuun naannoo Roosiyaatti fageenya guddaa irraa haleellaa raawwatteetti. Haleellaan kun humna waraanaa Roosiyaafi gargaarsa ishee kan ta'e teeknooloojii saatalaayitii dadhabsiisuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Gama biraatiin, Roosiyaan gargaarsa meeshaa waraanaa guddina qabu kan Ameerikaa irraa gara Yukreenitti darbuu danda'a jedhamee gabaasame irratti Ameerikaafi Turkii irraa ibsa gaafachaa jirti.

title: Israeli settlers besiege Palestinian families in occupied West Bank
english: Three Palestinian families in the occupied West Bank report being confined to their homes for almost a week due to Israeli settlers. These families claim that the settlers are deliberately blocking their access to basic necessities like food and water. The residents believe these actions are part of an effort by the settlers to forcibly seize their land and properties.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ሦስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች ምክንያት ላለፉት ስድስት ቀናት ከቤታቸው እንዳይወጡ መታገዳቸውን ገልጸዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ ሰፈራተኞቹ ምግብ፣ ውሃ እና ሌሎች አስፈላጊ አገልግሎቶችን እንዳያገኙ እንደከለከሏቸው ተናግረዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ ይህ ድርጊት መሬታቸውንና ንብረታቸውን በኃይል ለመውሰድ የታቀደ መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Dhihaa (West Bank) kan qabame keessa kan jiraatan maatiiwwan Falasxiin sadii, torban tokkoo oliif jiraattota Israa'elii kanneen bakkeewwan fudhataniin manaa akka hin baane ugguramuu ibsaniiru. Maatiiwwan kunneen jiraattonni kunneen nyaataa fi bishaan dabalatee tajaajiloota bu'uuraa akka hin arganne dhoorkaa jiraachuu himu. Namoonni kunneen gochi kun qabeenyaa fi lafa isaanii humnaan saamuuf kan godhamaa jiru ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Israel’s ‘pilot zones’: Withdrawal on paper, continued occupation of south Lebanon
english: A new agreement involving Israel, the U.S., and Lebanon has established 'pilot zones' in three southern Lebanese villages to facilitate a gradual Israeli troop withdrawal. The plan requires the Lebanese Army to take control of these areas while ensuring Hezbollah militants are removed from the locations. Although framed as a step toward sovereignty, critics argue that these zones effectively maintain an ongoing Israeli presence in the region.
amharic: እስራኤል፣ አሜሪካ እና ሊባኖስ በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኙ ሶስት መንደሮችን እንደ 'ሙከራ ዞኖች' ለመሰየም ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ይህ እቅድ የእስራኤል ጦር ቀስ በቀስ ለቆ እንዲወጣ እና የሊባኖስ ጦር ስልጣኑን እንዲረከብ እንዲሁም የሂዝቦላህ ታጣቂዎች ከነዚህ አካባቢዎች እንዲወጡ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ስምምነቱ በወረቀት ላይ ቢሆንም፣ የሊባኖስ አካባቢዎች አሁንም በተግባር በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር መሆናቸው እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el, Ameerikaafi Libaanoos, gandaalee kibba Libaanoos keessa jiran saditti 'naannolee qorannoo' dhaabuuf walii galtee irra ga'aniiru. Karoorri kun waraanni Israa'el gadi lakkisee akka ba'uufi aangoon gara waraana Libaanoositti akka darbu, akkasumas gareen Hizbollaah naannolee sana keessaa akka ba'an taasisuuf kan qophaaye dha. Haa ta'u malee, qajeelfamni kun waraqaa irratti malee, dhugaa irratti Israa'el ammallee naannolee kana to'achaa jirti kan jedhu komiin jira.

title: Sedition to anthem: Many lives of ‘Azadi’ chants in India’s youth protests
english: The 'Azadi' slogan, which means freedom, has resurfaced as a powerful anthem for Indian students protesting against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government. Recently, these chants became a symbol of resistance during demonstrations following a major exam leak scandal that led to the Education Minister's resignation. While the phrase was once criminalized and associated with treason charges against student leaders a decade ago, it has now transformed into a mainstream rallying cry for youth activism across several Indian cities.
amharic: ነጻነትን የሚገልጸው 'አዛዲ' የሚለው መፈክር በህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ መንግስት ላይ በሚደረጉ የተማሪዎች የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ላይ እንደገና ዋና መዝሙር ሆኖ ብቅ ብሏል። በቅርቡ በትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ መልቀቅ ምክንያት በሆነው የፈተና መሰረቅ ቅሌት ተከትሎ በተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች ላይ ይህ መፈክር የትግሉ ምልክት ሆኗል። ከዚህ በፊት ከአስር አመት በፊት ይህ መፈክር እንደ ወንጀል ይታይ እና ተማሪዎችን ለከፍተኛ ችግር ይዳርግ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ግን በህንድ ከተሞች በስፋት የሚሰማ የወጣቶች የትግል ድምፅ ሆኗል።
oromo: Jechi 'Azadi' jedhu kan hiikni isaa bilisummaa ta'e, mormii barattoonni mootummaa Indiyaa kan Ministira Muummee Narendra Modi irratti godhaniif akka faaruu fi mallattoo guddaatti deebi'ee qabateera. Dhiheenya kana, qormaata biyyoolessaa waliin walqabatee rakkoo uumameen Ministirri Barnootaa aangoo gadi lakkisuun isaa mormii cimaa uumee, achirrattis jechi kun sagalee guddaa ta'eera. Waggaa kudhan dura jechi kun akka yakkaatti ilaalamaa fi hogganoota barattootaa irratti himannaa gurguddaa fidaa kan ture ta'us, har'a garuu guddinaa fi sagalee mormii dargaggootaa kan biyyattii ta'ee jira.

title: How blind football is helping women overcome barriers in Mexico
english: Mexico is set to participate in an international blind women's football tournament for the first time, represented by the Chilangas FC team. Players use a sound-emitting ball and verbal cues to navigate the pitch, breaking down societal barriers for visually impaired athletes. The team was formed after Coach Wendy del Rio noticed a lack of opportunities for women who wanted to play the sport, and she hopes their historic participation will inspire more women to join.
amharic: ሜክሲኮ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በዓለም አቀፍ የዓይነ ስውራን ሴቶች እግር ኳስ ውድድር ላይ በቺላንጋስ ኤፍሲ ቡድን አማካኝነት ለመሳተፍ ተዘጋጅታለች። ተጫዋቾቹ ድምፅ በሚያሰማ ኳስ እና በአሰልጣኞች መመሪያ በመታገዝ ይጫወታሉ፣ ይህ ደግሞ ለአካል ጉዳተኛ ሴቶች ያለውን ማህበራዊ መሰናክል ለመስበር ይረዳል። ቡድኑ የተቋቋመው አሰልጣኝ ወንዲ ዴል ሪዮ ለእግር ኳስ ፍላጎት ያላቸው ሴቶች በቂ እድል እንደሌላቸው በመገንዘቧ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ታሪካዊ ተሳትፎ ሌሎች ሴቶችንም ወደ ስፖርቱ እንዲመጡ ያነሳሳቸዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Meksiikoon yeroo jalqabaaf gartuu 'Chilangas FC' jedhamuun dorgommii kubbaa miilaa dubartoota ija hin qabnee kan idil-addunyaa irratti hirmaachuuf qophoofteetti. Taphattoonni kun kubbaa sagalee qabuufi qajeelfama gartuusaanii irraa argatan fayyadamuun taphatu; kunis dubartoota miidhaan qaamaa irra ga'eef gufuu hawaasummaa cabsuuf gargaara. Gartuun kun kan hundaa'e erga leenjistuu Wendy del Rio dubartoonni taphachuu barbaadan carraa akka hin qabne hubattee booda yoo ta'u, hirmaannaan isaanii kun dubartoota biroo hedduu gara ispoortii kanaatti akka dhufan kan kakaasu ta'a.

title: Israel’s ‘pilot zones’: Withdrawal on paper, continued occupation of south Lebanon
english: Under a 2026 agreement, three southern Lebanese villages have been established as 'pilot zones' intended to facilitate an Israeli withdrawal and restore Lebanese military control. However, analysts and observers report that Israel is using these areas to maintain its occupation rather than leaving, as evidenced by continued military attacks and destruction in nearby sectors. This situation highlights a significant gap between the formal agreement and the reality on the ground, where Israeli forces remain active despite the declared transition.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2026 በተደረገ ስምምነት መሠረት፣ የእስራኤልን ጦር መውጣት እና የሊባኖስን ጦር ቁጥጥር ለማመቻቸት ሶስት የደቡብ ሊባኖስ መንደሮች እንደ 'ሙከራ ዞኖች' ተወስነዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት እስራኤል እነዚህን አካባቢዎች የምትጠቀምባቸው ከጦርነት ለመውጣት ሳይሆን መሬቱን በቁጥጥሯ ስር ለማቆየት ነው። በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ አካባቢዎች የሚካሄደው ቀጣይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እና ውድመት፣ በስምምነቱ ወረቀት ላይ ካለው እቅድ እና በተግባር ካለው እውነታ መካከል ያለውን ሰፊ ክፍተት ያሳያል።
oromo: waliigaltee bara 2026 irraa ka’uun, baadiyoonni Kibba Libnaan sadii akka 'naannoo qormaataa' ykn 'pilot zones' kanneen humnoonni Israa'el itti bahanii fi mootummaan Libnaan to'annoo isaa itti deebisuuf yaadaman hundaa'aniiru. Ta'us, ogeeyyonni akka ibsanitti, Israa'el naannolee kana kan itti fayyadamaa jirtuufi bahuuf osoo hin taane, to'annoo ishee itti fufuuf ta'uun ni mirkanaa'a. Qarqara naannolee kanneenitti weerarri waraanaa fi diigumsi ammayyuu itti fufaa jiraachuun isaa, walii galtee barreeffamaa fi haala qabatamaa jiru gidduutti garagarummaa guddaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Israeli strikes kill 11 in southern Lebanon, Lebanese health ministry says​
english: Israeli military strikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of at least 11 people and left 19 others injured. The attacks targeted residential areas in the towns of Ansar and Deir al-Zahrani. This incident marks a significant escalation in violence shortly after a U.S.-brokered peace agreement was established.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 19 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ ያነጣጠረው በአንሳር እና በዴየር አል-ዛህራኒ ከተሞች በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የሰላም ስምምነት ከተደረገ በኋላ የተከሰተ ከፍተኛ የኃይል መባባስ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel kibba Libanonirratti haleellaa geggeesseen namoonni 11 ol du'aniiru, 19 immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame magaalaawwan Ansaar fi Deeyar al-Zahraanii keessatti mana jireenyaarratti ta'uu gabaasameera. Haleellaan kun marii nagaa Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taatee gaggeessite booda kan uumame yoo ta'u, rakkoo naannichaa kan hammeesse dha.

title: How Iran and Ukraine are strategically sinking their rivals at sea
english: Despite significant military pressure and airstrikes from the US and Israel, Iran has maintained its strategic resilience by utilizing its maritime capabilities to control key shipping routes. By threatening global energy markets through the Strait of Hormuz, Iran has successfully countered foreign military dominance and turned its naval leverage into bargaining power. This strategy highlights how controlling the seas allows a nation to withstand aerial attacks and force adversaries into diplomatic negotiations rather than achieving total military victory.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት ቢሰነዝሩም፣ ኢራን በባህር ላይ ባላት ቁጥጥር እና የስትራቴጂክ ማቋረጫ መስመሮችን በመቆጣጠር ሉዓላዊነቷን ማስጠበቅ ችላለች። የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን በመጠቀም በዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ማሳደሯ፣ የአየር ጥቃቶችን በመቋቋም ተቃዋሚዎቿን ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ እንድትመጣ አስችሏታል። ይህ ሁኔታ ሀገራት በባህር ላይ ያላቸው አቅም በአየር ላይ ከሚደርስ ጥቃት ለመከላከል እና ለፖለቲካዊ ጥቅም ለመጠቀም እንደሚያስችላቸው ያሳያል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Israa'el miidhaa qilleensaa cimaa ishee irratti gaggeessan iyyuu, Iraan dandeettii galaana ishee fi daandiiwwan daldala galaana ijoo to'achuudhaan of-danda'uu ishee itti fufteetti. Daandii Hormuz to'achuudhaan gabaa anniisaa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa gochuun, Iraan weerara qilleensaa of irraa ittisuu fi diinota ishee gara mariitti fidachuuf gargaareera. Karoorri kun, aangoon galaana irraa biyyoonni tokko weerara qilleensaa dandamatanii fi humni isaan galaana irraa qaban akka meeshaa marii fi dhimma siyaasaatti fayyadamuu akka danda'an agarsiisa.

title: Lebanese parliament speaker condemns Israeli 'massacre'
english: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in at least 11 deaths and 19 injuries. Lebanese parliamentary leader Nabih Berri strongly condemned the violence, labeling the offensive a massacre intended to destroy the population. Meanwhile, Hezbollah officials accused the Israeli government of escalating the conflict to gain political advantages and appease hardline supporters.

oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel kibba Libaanoos irratti qilleensaan haleellaa raawwateen namoonni 11 yoo du'an, 19 immoo madaa'aniiru. Gama biraatiin, gareen Hizbullaah, mootummaan Israa'eel faayidaa siyaasaa isaatiif jecha walitti bu'iinsa kana hammaachiisaa jira jechuun himateera.

title: Deadly Israeli strikes kill nine in southern Lebanon as tensions escalate
english: Israeli air strikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of at least nine people and caused numerous injuries. The attacks, which hit residential areas including Ansar and Deir al-Zahrani, have prompted Lebanon's Prime Minister to condemn the violence against civilians and reject Israel's claims that these locations were military targets. Meanwhile, Hezbollah has vowed to retaliate, warning that the ongoing regional escalation will not go unanswered.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች መገደላቸውንና በርካታ ቁስለኞች መኖራቸውን መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ። ጥቃቱ በአንሳር እና በዴየር አል-ዛህራኒ አካባቢ በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ የሊባኖስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጉዳዩን በማውገዝ ኢላማዎቹ ሲቪሎች እንጂ ወታደራዊ ቦታዎች እንዳልሆኑ ገልጸዋል። በበኩሉ ሂዝቦላህ ለደረሰው ጥቃት ተመጣጣኝ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ በማስታወቅ ውጥረቱ መባባሱን ገልጿል።

Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan namoonni keessa jiraatan Ansar fi Deir al-Zahrani irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, muummeen ministiraa Libanon haleellaa sivilii irratti raawwatame kana balaaleffataniiru. Gamtaan Hizbollaa gama isaatiin, haleellaa kanaaf deebii kan kennan ta'uu ibsuun, walitti bu'iinsi naannicha keessaa daran hammaachaa akka jiru beeksisaniiru.

title: The next Yemen war might be different
english: The conflict in Yemen is evolving as forces aligned with the internationally recognized government have begun utilizing drone warfare against the Houthis. While the Houthis still maintain a significant technological advantage, the government's ability to strike previously secure positions forces the rebel group to alter their tactical operations. Even without reaching full military parity, this shift in tactics represents a significant change in the nature of the ongoing war.
amharic: በየመን ያለው ግጭት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እውቅና የተሰጠው መንግሥት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች በሁቲዎች ላይ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን መጠቀም በመጀመራቸው አዲስ መልክ እየያዘ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሁቲዎች አሁንም የላቀ የቴክኖሎጂ አቅም ቢኖራቸውም፣ የመንግሥት ኃይሎች በጠላት ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸም መቻላቸው የሁቲዎችን የጦርነት ስልት እንዲቀይሩ አስገድዷቸዋል። ይህ ለውጥ ሙሉ በሙሉ ወታደራዊ አቻነት ባይኖርም፣ በጦርነቱ አካሄድ ላይ ትልቅ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።

Huthonni ammayyuu dandeettiifi teeknoolojii waraanaa guddaa kan qaban ta'us, humnootiin mootummaa bakkeewwan huthonni itti fayyadaman haleeluun isaanii, gareen kun adeemsa waraana isaa akka jijjiiru dirqisiiseera. Jijjiiramni kun humna waraanaa walqixa ta'e uumuu baatus, waraanichi akka kanaan duraa akka hin taane godheera.

title: Afghans mark five years of Taliban rule
english: Afghanistan recently observed the fifth anniversary of the Taliban's return to power, an event marked by ceremonies in Kabul that notably excluded most women. The country continues to face significant international isolation while grappling with a deepening humanitarian crisis. Furthermore, the systematic removal of women from public spaces remains a defining and concerning aspect of the current administration's rule.
amharic: አፍጋኒስታን የታልባን ወደ ስልጣን የተመለሱበትን አምስተኛ ዓመት በማስታወስ በካቡል የክብር ስነስርዓት አከናውነዋል። በስነስርዓቱ ላይ አብዛኛው ሴቶች እንዳይሳተፉ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ አገሪቱ አሁንም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተገልላ በከባድ ሰብዓዊ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። በተጨማሪም ሴቶች ከህዝባዊ ህይወት እየተገለሉ መምጣታቸው የአሁኑ አስተዳደር ዋነኛ መገለጫ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Afgaanistaan waggaa shan guutuu mootummaan Taalibaan aangoo irra jiraachuu isaa yaadatanii jiru. title: Black professor at centre of Cambridge plagiarism row found dead
english: Dr. Jason Arday, a professor at Cambridge University, has passed away shortly after resigning from his position following allegations of plagiarism. His family has publicly denounced the intense media scrutiny he faced, describing the coverage as a targeted misinformation campaign. Reports indicate that over 180 articles were published about the professor within a brief nine-day period.

oromo: Pirofesara Yuunivarsitii Kaambiriij kan ta'an Dr. Jeeson Ardeey, himannaa yakka hatuu qorannoo (plagiarism) irraa ka'uudhaan hojii gadhiisanii guyyoota muraasa booda du'anii argamaniiru. Maatiin isaanii miidiyaaleen irratti xiyyeeffannoo cimaa godhan 'duula odeeffannoo sobaa' akka ta'e ibsuun balaaleeffataniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, guyyoota sagal keessatti qofa pirofesaricha irratti barruuleen 188 ol maxxanfamanii turan.

title: Vienna woman sues city for discrimination over toilet fees
english: A woman living in Vienna has initiated a lawsuit against the city, claiming that public restroom pricing is unfair. She argues that women face discrimination because they are required to pay for toilet stalls, while men are able to use urinals without any charge. The activist is seeking to challenge this disparity in public facility access.

oromo: Dubartiin magaalaa Viyeenaa jiraattu tokko, tajaajila mana fincaanii hawaasaa irratti garaagarummaan jiraachuu isaatiin magaalaa sana irratti himata banatteetti. Dubartoonni mana fincaanii fayyadamuuf kaffaltii kan kaffalan yoo ta'u, dhiironni garuu kaffaltii malee itti fayyadamuu danda'uun isaanii jibba fi addaan qooduudha jechuun falmiti. Inni kunis akkaataa tajaajila hawaasaa irratti wal-qixxummaan akka jiraatu gaafatti.

title: Five wounded in shooting at Virginia State University
english: Five people were injured, including one critically, during a shooting incident near residence halls at Virginia State University early Saturday morning. Local authorities initiated a campus-wide lockdown as they searched for multiple suspects, though the order has since been lifted. An investigation is currently underway, and police are urging anyone with relevant information to come forward just days before the start of the fall semester.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ማለዳ በቨርጂኒያ ስቴት ዩኒቨርሲቲ ግቢ ውስጥ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ አምስት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል፤ ከነዚህም መካከል የአንዱ ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ነው። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ፖሊስ ግቢውን ዘግቶ ፍተሻ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ተጠርጣሪዎችን ለማግኘት ምርመራው ቀጥሏል። ተማሪዎች ትምህርት ሊጀምሩ ጥቂት ቀናት ሲቀራቸው በተፈጠረው በዚህ ድርጊት ላይ መረጃ ያላቸው አካላት ለፖሊስ እንዲያሳውቁ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Ganama Sanbata ganama dhaabbata barnoota ol Aanaa Virginia State University jedhamutti dhukaasa halkan kanaan gahe namoota shan irratti miidhaan gaheera; isaan keessaa tokko haalli isaa hamaa dha. Poolisiin shakkamtoota hedduu barbaadaa turee fi wayita ammaa hordoffiin kun itti fufee jira. Barnoonni waggaa haaraa jalqabamuuf guyyoota muraasa hafan kanatti, namoonni waa'ee dhukaasa kanaa beektan poolisiif gumaacha gochuu akka dandeessan dhaamsa dabarsaniiru.

title: Iran accuses French diplomats of 'infiltration'
english: Iranian authorities have formally accused two French diplomats of attempting to infiltrate and interfere in the country's internal affairs. The intelligence ministry claims these individuals were caught at a clandestine location with documents suggesting they were building unauthorized networks. No concrete proof has been presented, and the French government has not yet responded to these allegations.
amharic: የኢራን መንግሥት ሁለት የፈረንሳይ ዲፕሎማቶች በሀገሪቱ የውስጥ ጉዳይ ላይ ጣልቃ በመግባት ሰርጎ ለመግባት ሲሞክሩ እንደነበር ከሰሰ። የኢራን የስለላ ሚኒስቴር እንዳለው ዲፕሎማቶቹ ሚስጥራዊ በሆነ ቦታ ተገኝተዋል እንዲሁም መደበኛ ያልሆነ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር ሲያሴሩ የሚያሳይ ሰነድ ተገኝቷል። በጉዳዩ ላይ እስካሁን ድረስ ምንም አይነት ተጨባጭ ማስረጃ አልቀረበም እንዲሁም የፈረንሳይ መንግሥትም እስካሁን አስተያየት አልሰጠም።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan dippilomatoota Faransaay lama biyyattii keessatti sochiin duubatti deebi'anii seenuufi gidduu galuu gaggeessaniiru jechuun himateera. Ministeerri odeeffannoo Iraan akka jedhutti, dippilomatootni kunneen bakka icitii tokkotti qabamanii, ragaa walitti dhufeenya seeraan alaa uumuf yaalii gochaa turan agarsiisu argameera. Himannaa kanaaf ragaan qabatamaan dhiyaate hin jiru, mootummaan Faransaayis hanga ammaatti waan tokko hin jedhe.

title: Israeli drone strike injures three in central Gaza
english: An Israeli drone attack in Deir al-Balah, located in central Gaza, has left three Palestinians wounded. One of the victims is currently in a critical state following the strike. All individuals have been transported to Al-Aqsa hospital to receive medical attention.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ ዲር አል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አንዱ አደገኛ በሆነ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል። ሁሉም ጉዳተኞች ህክምና እንዲያገኙ ወደ አል-አቅሳ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል።
oromo: Humni Israa'el magaalaa Deir al-Balah kan giddu gala Gaazaatti argamtu irratti xiyyaara nama malee balali'uun haleellaa raawwateen namoonni sadii miidhamaniiru. Namoota miidhaman keessaa tokko haalli isaa hamaa akka ta'e gabaafameera. Miidhamtoonni hundi yaalamuu fi wal'aansa argachuuf gara hospitaala Al-Aqsa geessamaniiru.

title: Thirteen years after Rabaa massacre, families urge Egypt to free political prisoners
english: On the 13th anniversary of the Rabaa massacre, the Families of Egyptian Detainees Association has called on the government to release individuals imprisoned following the 2013 crackdown. The group argues that these protesters were unfairly turned into defendants after the violent dispersal of sit-ins that left at least 900 people dead. They are advocating for national reconciliation and the enforcement of constitutional provisions regarding transitional justice to address the ongoing detention of thousands of political prisoners.
amharic: የራባ ጭፍጨፋ ከተፈጸመ 13 ዓመታት በኋላ፣ የግብጽ እስረኞች ቤተሰቦች ማህበር መንግስት ከ2013ቱ የኃይል እርምጃ ጋር በተያያዘ የታሰሩ ሰዎችን እንዲለቅ ጠይቋል። ቡድኑ ቢያንስ 900 ሰዎች በተገደሉበት ወቅት ተቃዋሚዎች ከሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞች ወደ ተከሳሽነት መቀየራቸውን ገልጿል። ቤተሰቦቹ የሽግግር ፍትህን ተግባራዊ በማድረግ እና ብሔራዊ እርቅን በማምጣት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የፖለቲካ እስረኞች በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈቱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Humni ajjeechaa Rabaa waggaa 13 dura raawwatamee booda, Waldaan Maatii Hidhamtoota Gibxii mootummaan namoota bara 2013 erga hiriira sana booda hidhaman akka gadhiisu gaafate. Gareen kun, namoonni nageenyaan mormii dhageessisaa turan hiriirichi humnaan diigamee namoonni 900 ol ajjeefamanii booda, akka yakka hojjetanitti qabamuun isaanii sirrii akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Maatiin hidhamtootaa kun, biyyattiin gara araaga biyyaalessaatti akka deemtuuf fi seerota jijjiiramaa hojii irra oolchuun hidhamtoota siyaasaa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman akka gadhiiftu gaafataniiru.

title: Oxygen stations operating beyond capacity in Gaza
english: Gaza's healthcare system is facing a critical emergency as oxygen production facilities are severely overwhelmed. Due to restrictions on essential supplies entering the region, a large majority of oxygen stations and cylinders are no longer working. Officials emphasize that oxygen is a life-saving necessity, and its current shortage poses a grave threat to patients in critical care.

Ministirri fayyaa akka ibsetti, oksijiiniin lubbuu oolchuuf murteessaa waan ta’eef, hanqinni kun dhukkubsattoota iddoo yaala cimaa jiraniif balaa guddaa dha.

title: Israeli attacks kill nine people in southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military airstrikes in southern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of nine people and left several others injured. The casualties occurred during separate attacks on the villages of Deir ez-Zahrani and Ansar. The Israeli military has officially acknowledged carrying out these recent operations in the region.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ድብደባ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ የተፈጸሙት በዴየር ኤዝ-ዛህራኒ እና በአንሳር መንደሮች ላይ ነው። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በክልሉ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አረጋግጧል።

title: Five years on, how will Taliban deal with armed opposition?
english: Five years after regaining power, the Taliban continues to face various armed opposition groups across Afghanistan. While the United Nations confirms these groups remain active, they have failed to seize territory or pose a significant threat to Taliban control. Experts suggest these factions struggle to gain influence because they are often fragmented, poorly coordinated, and frequently operate from outside the country.
